status: Bounded GPU allocation history delivered and reconciled; GPI-S5 incomplete
problem: Weak allocation snapshots and aggregate release counters could not recover resources born and released between native turns, reference incidence changes, or pre-creation reservation peaks.
implementation: Optional bounded event buffer records existing registration, consumer/payload changes, prepared/submission reference changes, retirement, submitted uploads and final releases. Metadata mutations and resulting snapshots share the observer lock while enabled. Copied records retain no resource/owner handles. Event storage is allocated outside tracked payload scopes and outside the observer lock; no allocation occurs on append. Fixed capacity1..65536, sticky loss and monotonic sequences, unique observation identity and startup first-identity marker prevent silent truncation or stale consumers. Existing allocation/retirement/drop and admission ownership remain authoritative.
native: DATUM_GPU_ALLOCATION_TRACE creates a new file, with optional DATUM_GPU_ALLOCATION_TRACE_CAPACITY(default8192). Native App starts before renderer construction, drains on existing about-to-wait turns only when pending, and finishes after teardown. No new timer/redraw. Live resources reject completion, dropped/invalid/missing-start history rejects delivery, existing file is never overwritten. Disabled tracing allocates no event buffers or output; fixed observer bookkeeping and reservation peak atomics exist.
peak_boundary: Tracked-capacity peak measures registration through final-release observation, not exact API creation/drop instants: creation precedes registration and final observation follows resource drop. Concurrent callback ordering can therefore differ from actual API overlap. Separately added lifetime reservation peaks cover pre-creation admission and shared batch holds conservatively; these do not measure driver residency and are not individual private-call peaks. Existing PM047 per-call reports remain independent. No numerical memory acceptance follows from this conformance workload.
